display: Standardize error handling and exception formatting in docs/en/docs
summary: Adopt centralized exception handlers and structured RFC-7807 error responses across docs/en/docs.
rationale: Inconsistent error payloads between modules complicated API client development. Centralized validation and error mapping simplifies troubleshooting and client SDK generation.

display: Migrate configuration parameters to environment variables in docs/en/docs/advanced
summary: Move hardcoded and file-based runtime settings in docs/en/docs/advanced into 12-factor environment variables.
rationale: Decoupling deployment configuration from application code allows seamless multi-environment orchestration and containerized runtime configuration.

display: Deprecate legacy synchronous interfaces in fastapi/dependencies
summary: Formally deprecate blocking sync helpers in fastapi/dependencies in favor of native asynchronous patterns.
rationale: High-throughput asynchronous workloads were blocked by legacy synchronous helper calls, causing event loop starvation under peak loads.

display: Implement structured request lifecycle telemetry in tests
summary: Inject OpenTelemetry tracing spans and standardized metrics counters across key methods in tests.
rationale: Distributed tracing was incomplete without module-level span boundaries, delaying root-cause analysis during production latency spikes.

display: Enforce strict schema validation rules in fastapi/dependencies
summary: Require strict Pydantic model validation on all external inputs received by fastapi/dependencies.
rationale: Malformed payloads previously passed initial routing and triggered unexpected internal type errors deep within execution handlers.

display: Refactor dependency injection graph for tests/benchmarks
summary: Simplify dependency overrides and sub-dependency resolution logic in tests/benchmarks.
rationale: Circular references and deep nested scopes caused subtle caching issues when overriding dependencies in end-to-end integration test suites.

display: Optimize serialization and payload parsing in fastapi
summary: Benchmark and streamline high-volume JSON encoding and decoding routines within fastapi.
rationale: Profiling identified JSON serialization as the primary CPU bottleneck on data-heavy endpoints handling large collection responses.

display: Adopt granular permission scoping across fastapi/security
summary: Transition security scopes in fastapi/security to role-based access control with discrete capability tokens.
rationale: Coarse-grained authentication tokens gave services broader permissions than necessary, conflicting with least-privilege security requirements.

display: Isolate connection pooling and retry policies in docs/en/docs/advanced
summary: Configure dedicated client pool limits, timeouts, and exponential backoff strategies for docs/en/docs/advanced.
rationale: Exhaustion of global socket pools by bursty downstream calls caused cascading timeouts in unrelated user-facing services.

display: Implement idempotent state transitions in docs/en/docs
summary: Introduce idempotency keys and state preconditions for all mutating actions processed by docs/en/docs.
rationale: Network retries by distributed clients caused duplicate state mutations and intermittent race conditions during failover.

display: Standardize pagination semantics and metadata in docs/en/docs/reference
summary: Unify cursor-based pagination parameters and response envelopes across all listing endpoints in docs/en/docs/reference.
rationale: Mixed use of offset and cursor pagination confused API consumers and caused inconsistent memory spikes when reading large collections.

display: Enhance cache invalidation coordination for docs/en/docs
summary: Implement deterministic cache invalidation hooks triggered whenever entities in docs/en/docs change.
rationale: Stale cached reads persisted across updates because invalidation events lacked granular cache tag association.
